# Test fixtures

Tiny movies for the test harness, generated by `make_test_swf.py` (pure Python 3, no
dependencies, created for this toolkit and covered by its MIT license). They contain no
third party content.

| File | Last frame does | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_quit.swf` | traces `fixture quitting`, then `fscommand("quit")` | the player must exit by itself with code 0 |
| `test_relaunch.swf` | traces `fixture relaunching`, then `fscommand("relaunch", "next")` | the player must print the relaunch marker line (`RUFFLE_RELAUNCH next`) on stdout and exit |
| `test_loop.swf` | nothing, the timeline loops | screenshot tests, stopped by the harness |
| `test_keys.swf` | like `test_loop.swf`, and every frame traces `key Left is down` or `key Space is down` while `Key.isDown` reports that key | key injection tests (`RUFFLE_SDL_KEYS`, `keyd.py`) |
| `test_static.swf` | one frame with the same shapes and a `stop()`, nothing ever changes | pixel exact comparisons (`tests/cursor_test.sh`) |

All of them are uncompressed (`FWS`) version 8 AVM1 movies, 640x480 at 30 fps, 90 frames (`test_static.swf`: 1 frame, the rest 3 seconds
per loop). Four coloured rectangles (DefineShape plus PlaceObject2 with a move on every frame)
sweep across a dark background and the first one flashes through a colour transform, so two
screenshots taken at different times differ. Frame 1 traces `fixture started`, which shows up in
the log as an `avm_trace` line when `RUST_LOG` includes `avm_trace=info`.

## Regenerate and check

```
python3 make_test_swf.py .                 # writes the three files and checks them
python3 make_test_swf.py --check a.swf     # list the tags of a SWF
python3 ../../tools/swf/swf_info.py test_quit.swf   # version, size, frame rate, AVM1/AVM2
```

The generator is deterministic, so regenerating gives identical bytes.

## Verified behaviour

Loaded in a Ruffle front end built from the patched tree on Xvfb: no tag errors, the start trace
appears, `test_quit.swf` exits with code 0 after about 3 seconds, and `test_relaunch.swf` prints
the relaunch marker line with the argument `next` before exiting, and `test_keys.swf` logs the
injected keys. (An older binary that still
used a game named marker printed that name instead; the series in `ruffle/patches` renames it.)

## Adding a fixture

Add a variant name to the loop at the bottom of `make_test_swf.py` and a branch in `build()`.
Keep fixtures small (these are under 5 KB each) and keep them generated from code, not binary
blobs from elsewhere.
